name: Rise of the Sith
description: The Sith Order emerges as a powerful faction in the galaxy.

name: The Phantom Menace
description: The Sith Lord Darth Sidious orchestrates a political crisis, leading to the rise of the Galactic Empire.

name: Clone Wars
description: The galaxy-wide conflict between the Galactic Republic and the Separatist Alliance.

name: Rise of the Galactic Empire
description: Supreme Chancellor Palpatine declares himself Emperor and transforms the Republic into the Galactic Empire.

name: The Rebellion Begins
description: The Rebel Alliance forms to resist the rule of the Galactic Empire.

name: A New Hope
description: The Rebel Alliance destroys the Death Star, giving hope to the galaxy.

name: The Empire Strikes Back
description: The Galactic Empire strikes back against the Rebel Alliance.

name: Return of the Jedi
description: The Rebel Alliance defeats the Emperor and the Galactic Empire.

name: The Force Awakens
description: A new threat, the First Order, rises to power.
